## EA Media Tools 2.1.0 - jaguar

### Adaptive NVENC batches

- NVENC batches begin with one encode and sample aggregate average FPS every 10 seconds.
- Another job starts only when at least 200 FPS is available for every active job plus the proposed job.
- Growth stops at the detected workload limit or the supported NVENC session cap, and a completed slot observes a 10-second cooldown before taking another source.

### Smart series naming

- Single video encodes use clean `<Show Name> SxxExxx.<extension>` names when an episode marker is detected.
- Folder batches are organized beneath `converted/<Show Name (Year)>/Season xx`, including batches that span multiple seasons.

### Streaming and crop updates

- Streaming maximum video rates are 5000 kbit/s for 1080p and 8000 kbit/s for 4K; buffer size remains automatic.
- NVIDIA auto-crop uses an available codec-specific CUVID decoder and applies `-crop` before the input, avoiding a hardware-to-software crop round trip.
- Inputs with attached cover art address the primary video stream directly instead of disabling CUVID.

### Interface cleanup

- The gear menu no longer includes preset INI or preset-folder shortcuts. Preset editing instructions remain in the README.

### Validation

- Lint, native and compatibility TypeScript checks, unit tests, and production packaging.

[Review all changes since v2.0.1](https://github.com/eaforlife/media-converter/compare/v2.0.1...v2.1.0).
